title: The model, taught by EX-0002, declares every movement of the heal cut
author: lane/lab-p2-readers
question: Once the model graph reads what EX-0002 measured (O-HEAL reads the heal cut, O-DPS and O-KILLS read the hunted share), does the heal cut move anything it does not declare, and do the sweeps still agree with its signs?
hypothesis: No outcome moves undeclared under the heal cut (the sustain readers move as the trace says: sustainRatio down, regenShare measured up where the trace reads it mixed), and the sign match on the balance sweeps (run 44923615395) does not fall: no new sign miss

results.name: EX-0004-declared.json
results.what: readers.mjs --declared on EX-0002's two runs with the model as fixed (c51da94ce)

summary.model: the tree at c51da94ce: O-HEAL reads -heal.cut, O-DPS and O-KILLS read +huntedShare
summary.signedAndCalled: every outcome measured up or down was declared with the same sign (dps, dpsHero, killsPerH, healPerH, lowHpTypical, lowHpP10, hpUnder30, hpUnder10, deathsPer1000h, huntedShare, suppliesPerH, storePerH, netPerH, netLevelXpPerH, sustainRatio)
summary.notCalled: regenShare (the trace reads it mixed at depth 2, measured up)
deadOutcomes: hoursPerLevel (0 of 156 cells: the cells whose net Level XP moved fell to none and drop out)
manaWaitsPerH (2 of 177: the reference bars almost never wait for mana)

sweepsSignMatch.note: read during the fix, before this record was written: a reading, not a test

conclusion: Held for the heal cut: no outcome moved undeclared, and every outcome measured up or down was declared with the same sign. regenShare stays the trace's one uncalled outcome (mixed at depth 2, measured up). Two declared outcomes did not move: hoursPerLevel, whose moved cells fell to no net Level XP and drop out, and manaWaitsPerH, which today's bars almost never raise. The sweeps' sign match went from 251 of 257 to 262 of 268 with no new miss, read during the fix and before this record, so that part is a reading and not a test
